messages:
michelle_pm: ACME wants an Optimize pilot: per-route batching/cache/quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts and auto-fallback. Minimal pilot scope?

rahul_eng: Suggest pilot = adaptive microbatching + per-route KV caching + int8 recommendations. No int4.

michelle_pm: ACME has chat (low-latency) and summarization (throughput) routes. We need per-route defaults.

alex_cs: They can provide corpora for both routes. They also want cost reporting.

sara_ml: Eval alerts: compare live outputs to baseline on customer corpus. Trigger when relative quality drop >2% and absolute delta >0.5% for key metrics. On alert: sample 100% for 30m.

tim_sre: Rollout: per-customer feature flag + canary (5-25-100%) + global kill. Expose batch_size_hist, cache_hit_rate, p99.

marco_infra: Runtime knobs: chat max_wait_ms 5-25ms, summarization 100-200ms. Recommend cache_ttl and prefetch to avoid cold hits.

rahul_eng: Proto config (pilot):
```yaml
routes:
  - name: chat
    adaptive_batch: true
    max_wait_ms: 15
    max_batch: 8
    suggest_quant: int8
  - name: summarization
    adaptive_batch: true
    max_wait_ms: 150
    max_batch: 64
    suggest_quant: int8
eval_alerts:
  rel_drop: 0.02
  abs_min: 0.005
  sampling_on_alert: 1.0
```

jenna_product: Launch gates: 72h staging soak with p99 targets met, eval alerts fire on synthetic regressions, canary toggles work, runbook + docs. 3-week pilot.

michelle_pm: Decisions: include int8 in pilot, int4 postponed. Actions: rahul - perf table by route; sara - hook eval + thresholds; marco - sampling + nightly perf test; tim - canary controls; jenna - PRD + runbook; alex - get corpora. ACK here when done.
